name: sp_362_Normalized
description:
The Elasticsearch storage configuration for Snowplow has been defined with the identifier **snowplow-es-config**. It points to the cluster at **es.example.com** on the standard port **9200**, targeting the index named **snowplow-failed-events**. The storage type is **elasticsearch**, and the configuration is intended exclusively for handling **FAILED_EVENTS**.

Note that the setting **nodesWanOnly** is set to **false**, meaning the nodes are not restricted to WAN‑only access. This setup ensures that failed event data can be written directly to the designated Elasticsearch index without WAN‑only constraints.
